question: Does a wider sweep of the type-set WCSP beat the original frozen setting on fresh images?
data: PanNuke folds 1 and 3, all organs except Adrenal_gland. Fit: ground truth only. Dev and test: frozen HoVer-Net, full 256x256 patches, same inference as instances_20261114.
organ_specific_rule: Counts per organ, smoothed toward the all-organ count for the same nucleus-count group with the same smoothing weight. Organs missing from fit use all-organ counts.
selection: Highest pooled five-class biological mIoU on dev. Within 0.0001, the simplest setting wins: all-organ before per-organ, original groups before others, weaker strength, original mode, then vote/mean/log_mean, then smoothing closest to 16.
primary: sweep winner vs. original setting with original counts
primary_test: Two-sided paired bootstrap over whole images, 5000 replicates, seed 20261123, confusion matrices pooled before IoU; Holm across the two primary comparisons; 'works' means Holm p < 0.05 with a positive gain.
exploratory: original setting refit on the new fit images vs. original counts (more data)
sweep winner vs. original setting refit (better knobs)
test curve over strength with the winner's other knobs fixed
written: Before any dev or test scoring.
